answer: Each island keeps one mesa, and every operator has a row there naming all the heads it owns, so any stranger can read a slate before signing. A head counts only if a stranger from another island signs it, and no stranger signs twice for one operator; each signer's fee is one pearl for every head of the row it backs, so an operator's Nth head costs N pearls to a Nth stranger. A thousand clones need a thousand strangers and a million pearls; an honest newcomer needs one of each.
